create_ReplayGuiAppRenderer: create a ReplayGuiAppRenderer instance with a window size and optional viewport rectangle for replay rendering
post_sim_update_keyframes: call post_sim_update to set keyframes and camera transform for the replay renderer environment
render_update_frame: call render_update to render the current frame with camera transform, debug images, and text overlays
unproject_viewport_position: call unproject to convert a viewport position into world coordinates using the replay renderer
set_image_drawer: call set_image_drawer to replace the default ImageFramebufferDrawer with a custom image drawing instance
